data.name: Fikriyyah
data.gender_notes: Fikriyyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Fikriyyah comes from the root 'fikra', which means 'memory, thought, idea'. It is a name rich in spiritual significance, symbolizing the importance of deep contemplation and reflection in one's faith and daily life. The name Fikriyyah carries the meaning “Memory, Thought, Idea” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fikriyyah usually hope their child will grow to embody memory, thought, idea and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fikriyyah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

The name can be seen as a reminder to strive for knowledge and wisdom, and to approach life with a sense of intention and purpose.
data.spiritual_significance: For Muslims, the name Fikriyyah holds deep spiritual significance. It is a reminder of the importance of dhikr (remembrance of Allah) and reflection on the divine teachings of the Quran and Sunnah. Fikriyyah encourages us to connect with our inner selves and to cultivate a strong and loving relationship with Allah. By embodying this name, we are not only honoring the Legacy of our Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), but also striving to live up to the highest ideals of our faith. Ultimately, Fikriyyah is a name that inspires us to seek knowledge, to grow spiritually, and to live in accordance with the will of Allah.
